visual.description: White navigation bar with logo left, centered nav links with dropdowns, and two CTA buttons right-aligned.
Dark green full-width hero with a large lime-green text block overlapping a photo on the left and a dashboard UI card floating top-right, creating a collage-style layout with no clean column grid.
Full-width dark green section with a single centered body text paragraph and two CTA buttons.
Two equal rounded-corner cards side by side — left card is off-white with text and UI illustrations, right card is lime-green with text and a dashboard screenshot.
Full-width dark green section with a large centered heading, body text, and two CTA buttons above an isometric stack illustration.
Left side shows a large isometric layered-stack illustration; right side shows a vertical legend list of labeled color swatches.
Two rows of five evenly spaced customer logos on a dark green background with no borders or cards.
Lime-green card dominates the left (~75%) with a large block quote; a portrait photo card is anchored top-right with a smaller attribution card bottom-left.
Full-width lime-green section containing a rounded dark-green card split into left (product screenshot) and right (label, heading, body, CTA button) halves.
Left column holds a label, large heading, and a platform-overview button; right column shows a 2x2 feature-tile grid with icons and labels.
Dark green section with an oversized lime-green 'M' letterform bleeding left, overlaid by a centered lime-green card with heading, subtext, and two CTA buttons.
Dark green footer with logo and social/legal info in a wide left column and three equal columns of hierarchical nav links on the right.
